title: fix(runtime)!: REST's /actions door refuses an action on an object whose owning package is disabled 404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED, before any handler runs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXquM9v2r8ymXj6TzynfjMF)_

Fixes #25296

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

REST's `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/NAME` now asks, before it reads the action's declaration, whether the object it names is served. An object whose owning package is disabled is refused `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`, with the error the protocol raises for it on the data plane and on `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME`, before any gate, record load or handler. The question is asked through the by-name object read the data verbs' exposure gate already makes (`readExposureDeclaration`), so neither the package predicate nor the refusal is copied.

## The defect, measured on base `5801a4f2c9`

The `/actions` door (`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`, the one owner of the route) resolved the action's declaration through `resolveRouteActionDeclaration`, which reads `ql.getSchema(OBJECT)` and the registry's `action` items. A disabled package's objects stay registered there, so the declaration resolved and the door dispatched, while every other door treats the package as gone.

Real kernels (`ObjectKernel` + `MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin` over a better-sqlite3 `SqlDriver`), in the two shapes the #25120 rig pins (`env_local` with `createStandaloneStack`'s options, and no `environmentId`), driven through the runtime dispatcher's `dispatch()`. The fixture package, registered through the `manifest` service during the boot and then disabled (`registry.disablePackage`): one object carrying a script action `ping` (its handler registered), a declarative update `mark_done`, a script action `admin_ping` gated by `requiredPermissions: ['manage_metadata']`, and a top-level declarative update `bound_done` bound to the object.

| request, as a signed-in caller without `manage_metadata` | base, both shapes | this PR, both shapes |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `GET /data/OBJECT` (the data plane, unchanged) | `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` | same |
| `POST /actions/OBJECT/ping` | **`200 { pong: true }`, the handler ran** | `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` |
| `POST /actions/OBJECT/ping/r_any` | **`200`, the handler ran** | `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` |
| `POST /actions/OBJECT/mark_done` with a `recordId` | refused only at the record load | `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` |
| `POST /actions/OBJECT/bound_done` with a `recordId` | refused only at the record load | `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` |
| `POST /actions/OBJECT/admin_ping` | `403` (the D4 gate read the declaration) | `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` |
| `POST /actions/OBJECT/qa_nowhere` | the "no declaration" `404` (no code) | `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` |
| the same `ping`, anonymous | `401` | `401` (the anonymous baseline stays first) |
| the same `ping`, after `registry.enablePackage` | `200` | `200` |

The base column is the pins' main leg below.

## What changed

- **`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`.** `refuseDisabledPackageObject(deps, requestContext, object, scopeId?)`: it asks `readExposureDeclaration` (the protocol's by-name object read on its execution face, which `refuseUnexposedDataAction` already asks) and rethrows only the protocol's `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` refusal (`isObjectPackageDisabledRefusal`). Any other answer is not its to give: an absent object is the declaration resolution's to answer, and so is an unreadable metadata plane (ADR-0110 D3). Not published by `index.ts`.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`.** `handleActionsRequest` asks it once the engine is resolved and the activation write door has had its turn, before the declaration resolution; a refusal is answered through `deps.errorFromThrown(err, 404)`, the exit every other domain catch uses, so the envelope carries the protocol error's own `code` and `status`. An object-less invocation (`POST /actions/global/NAME`, `POST /actions//NAME`) names no object and is not asked about.
- **`.changeset/25296-rest-actions-disabled-package.md`.** A `patch` for `@objectstack/runtime`, with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; both declaration lines are in the body.

## Contract

Every input whose answer changes, old to new, on `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/NAME[/RECORD]` where OBJECT's owning package is disabled, on every kernel shape:

1. **A script action with a registered handler.** Old: `200`, the handler's result (its body ran, `isSystem`-elevated as a script body always is). New: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; the handler is not called.
2. **A declarative update (embedded, or a top-level action bound to the object).** Old: refused at the record load. New: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` before the record load.
3. **An action gated by `requiredPermissions` the caller lacks.** Old: `403`. New: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. The data plane also answers the package refusal ahead of any permission check, and the refusal names the object, which the data plane already discloses to the same caller.
4. **An action switched off in the activation ledger.** Old: `409 ACTION_DISABLED` (after D4). New: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. Not pinned separately: the gate sits ahead of the ledger consult by construction, as it sits ahead of D4 in case 3.
5. **A name nothing declares.** Old: the "no declaration" `404` with its prescription. New: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`.
6. **A `flow` action.** Old: dispatched through the automation service (or `503` without one). New: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. Not pinned separately: the rig has no automation service, and the gate runs before the type dispatch for every type.

Unchanged: the anonymous baseline (`401`) and the `405` stay first; an enabled package's actions run as before behind every gate (pinned as the control on both shapes); re-enabling the package restores its actions at once, because nothing records the refusal (pinned); an object-less action; the activation door (`POST /actions/_activation/OBJECT/NAME`); a host whose protocol has no by-name read (no refusal, as before). The cost is one by-name object read per invocation on an object route, the read the data verbs' gate already makes per call.

## Pins

- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions-disabled-package.test.ts`, new, 24 cases on real kernels.** Per shape: the ENABLED control (`ping` answers `200 { pong: true }` and its handler runs once; `mark_done` and `bound_done` update a record seeded through `POST /data/OBJECT`, `200`; `admin_ping` answers `403`; an undeclared name answers `404` with no package code), and the DISABLED package (precondition: `GET /data/OBJECT` answers `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; each of the six invocations of the table answers `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` with the handler never called and the protocol's `getData` / `updateData` and the engine's `executeAction` never reached; the anonymous caller still answers `401`; after `enablePackage`, `ping` runs again). A new file, not the #25120 rig file, which the #25297 card holds.

**Red before, green after.** The directions were predicted before each run. Both mutated legs ran the pin file under the verify lock on `99d375e8` (this PR's head); the test imports the runtime's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

| leg | mutation | result | which failed |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| main | the base tree's `action-execution.ts` and `domains/actions.ts` (`git restore --source=5801a4f2`, worktree only), restored by `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty | 12 failed, 12 passed | the six refusal cases on both shapes |
| helper | `refuseDisabledPackageObject` swallows the refusal too (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `9e202cd4e8a7` to `0711946f42aa`; restored blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty) | 12 failed, 12 passed | the same twelve |
| fix | none | 24 passed | none |

## Local verification

On `99d375e84c`, over `origin/main` `5801a4f2c9`. Every heavy run went through the verify lock; each line cites its `VERDICT`.

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --filter=@objectstack/driver-turso --concurrency=3`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 66 of 66 tasks (the runtime's closure included; `driver-turso` because the runtime's test typecheck reads it).
- The pin file (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/actions-disabled-package.test.ts`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 24 passed.
- `@objectstack/runtime` unit suite (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`; Test Files 437 passed (437); Tests 6952 passed, 19 skipped (6971).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (`tsc --noEmit`, and `check:test-typecheck` OK). A first run before `driver-turso` was built answered one TS2307 in `organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts` (a missing dist, not this diff).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed source and test files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 68 families derived, each run, every one `exit 0`. Two first answered `exit 3` (prerequisites, not verdicts): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` until its pinned fixture commit was fetched, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` until the eight dists it named were built. `check:type-check-debt` ran under the lock.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 68 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- The full dogfood battery is owed once on the final head (the `!` and the `(narrowing)` arm); its counts follow as a PR comment.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured, not changed here: a disabled package's object-less action still runs through REST.** A top-level action with no `objectName`, shipped by the package (`type: 'script'`, its handler registered under `global`), answered `200` with its handler's result on `POST /actions/global/NAME` and `POST /actions//NAME` after `registry.disablePackage`, on both shapes, while `GET /api/v1/meta/action/NAME` answered `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Scratch probe over this PR's rig, not committed. The card's shape is the object route and its `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` answer; an object-less action has no object to refuse, and which answer it owes (the "no declaration" `404`, as the by-name `/meta` read answers it, is the likely reading) is the next card's to settle. The #25297 card moves MCP's object-less actions onto the merged action listing, which omits them.
- **`refuseAmbiguousActionActivation` was not needed.** The card asked whether this fix needs the activation-ambiguity check to read the served listing. It does not: the fix reads no collection, and the check serves the activation door, which this PR leaves alone. Whether that check sees a package object's actions on an `environmentId` kernel is unchanged and unmeasured here.
- **The activation door is untouched.** Flipping a disabled package's action in the activation ledger still works; it writes a ledger row and runs nothing.
- **Branch name.** This PR's branch is `claude/project-thread-vlqmr4`, the name the session was given, not `claude/issue-25296-…`; the Duplicate Fix Guard may say so. The claim (comment 6352124313) names it.
